crm_notes: Account: mid-stage fintech — heavy trading/alerts product that surfaces model suggestions in <100ms to desk traders.
Primary ask: predictable sub-50ms p50 for short-turn chat + 2–3k rps during peaks. Extremely cost-sensitive at scale.
Interest areas: batching heuristics (auto- vs manual), prefix/KV caching to avoid repeated context costs, aggressive quantization (4-bit/INT8) on non-critical models.
CTO quote: "We can't tolerate spikes that double token cost — show us concrete unit economics for batching + quantization."
SE notes: prefer dedicated GPU pool in US-EAST for latency; may move sensitive workloads to on-prem for regulatory flows (EU data residency for Europe desk).
Procurement: prefers annual reserved capacity but wants fallback to hosted during burst windows — asks about automatic routing + SLA for fallback.
Tech ask: reproducible perf harness (we want the exact inference request patterns), kernel-level logs for worst-case tail latency investigations.
POC definition: validate p50/p95 for chat at target throughput, measure token cost delta with/without caching and with quantized model variants, show A/B for quality regressions.
Action items: SE to provide perf harness repo + runbook; AE to send Dedicated pricing sheet; security to get SOC2 artifacts + KMS flow; schedule soak test.
use_case_summary: Northbridge InferGate is evaluating Redwood to replace an internal Triton-based stack for their trader-assist chat and real-time reranking pipeline. Primary goals are: keep p50 latency <= 50ms for short chat exchanges, support bursts to 2–3k rps with predictable unit cost, and reduce per-token spend via batching, KV caching, and model quantization. They need benchable, auditable results and a deployment that can run in VPC or on-prem for regulated European trading desks.
notes_short: perf-focused fintech. want benchmarking + cost delta analysis for batching/caching/quantization. security + budget are main blockers.
sales_play: SE-led POC focused on perf benchmarking and quant economics — goal: move to 12-month dedicated commit if POC validates latency/cost targets.
